message: Use America/New_York (Eastern Time) for 9 a.m. on January 20, 2027.
history: Could you remind me on January 20 to order a gift for Aunt Ruth?
Sure—January 20, 2027 is the next January 20. What time and time zone should I use for the reminder?
What time zone should I use for 9 a.m.? I need it to schedule the reminder correctly.
